lines.en: One of my steps and the ground groans.

lines.zh: 肚子上的管子，一晃一晃。
lines.en: The tubes on my gut sway.
Too heavy; walking is a chore.
My arms are thicker than my legs.
I shift slowly along the lava pools.
Two steps, a pause to breathe.
This bulk stops blades and bolts.
My feet sink craters in the ground.
The stuff in my tubes sloshes.
Every step of mine counts.
I grind the nether rock underfoot.
Slow, and still faster than you.
Standing, my belly rises and falls.
Something gurgles in my tubes.
Firelight roasts my back.
I wipe my mouth.
This space is too small for me to turn.
My grunt sounds like thunder.
I flex my fists.
The fire in my tubes burns slow.
I lean on the rock and breathe.
This hide is absurdly thick.
You look small from up here.
I look at you; my belly moves first.

lines.zh: 你这身板，不够我一只手。
lines.en: You're not one hand's worth of me.
Not too close; I might step on you.
See the fire on my tubes?
Run, and I won't chase.
I honestly prefer fighting at range.
My cannon is pointed at you.

lines.zh: 你这一身铁味，很远就闻到。
lines.en: Your iron stink carries a long way.
I grin; my teeth are big.
Thick hide still hurts.
I take half a step; the ground shakes.
A hole opens in a tube.
I bend low and plant my feet again.
The fire in my tubes wavers.
Blood and lava run together.
My belly heaves badly.
Not the tubes.
It hurts; it won't kill me.
I clench my fists.
Eat? I just ate.
That's not a mouthful for me.
You hold it out like a toothpick.
I prefer mine roasted.
That much only fills a gap in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我的胃口很大，你供不起。
lines.en: My appetite is large; you can't feed it.
It does smell decent.
Set it down; let me look.
Step back two paces first.
Never mind; not interested.
Ram me? I'm a wall of meat.
My belly bounces you away.
That made my belly jiggle.

lines.zh: 让开，我转身太快会撞到。
lines.en: Move; my turns knock things over.
Mind the tubes; they're hot.
I step back and the ground sinks.
That much force makes me laugh.
I shift to make room.
Don't cling to my leg.
Steady; don't get shaken down.
This size makes companionship hard.
In firelight, we're both ugly.

lines.zh: 同类见面，先比谁的管子粗。
lines.en: Kin compare tubes first.
This bulk of mine can still squeeze in beside you.
My gut blocks the view.
A grunt serves as a greeting.
Let's share the fire.
With this bulk, we'd squeeze.
Don't mind my tubes.
Then let's take it slowly.
One palm scoops it up.
My fingers are too thick to pinch.
It's a bean in my grip.
One squeeze and it crushes.
I lift it to look.

lines.zh: 我两根手指就把它夹扁。
lines.en: Two of my fingers flatten it.
I stuff it in my belt pouch.
Too heavy; I drop it.
It falls and I crush it underfoot.
I can only pinch up one grain at a time.
Something shifted ahead.
I raise my head; my tubes glow.
Cannon aimed.
This range is just right.
Stand still.

lines.zh: 我的火，不用靠近也能打。
lines.en: My fire reaches without closing in.
The bead is already on you.
I'd rather not walk.
This shot will be loud.
You still have time to dodge.
Both of my cannon mouths glow at once.
The tubes begin to pressurize.
I laugh, a muffled sound.
That settles it.
Fire churns in my tubes.
One more sight adjustment.
Hold still so I can aim.
At this range, you can't run.
I shuffle my feet into place.
The lava glow helps.
My tubes grow hotter.
I hear my own belly rumble.
My fire can curve around that rock.
The bead is on you.
I exhale; it's hot.
This shot is charged.
Hear the sound in my tubes.
This cannon won't stop itself.
One last second of margin.
The fire in my tubes goes out.
My fist comes crashing down!
A sweeping arm — get clear.
This kick could go through a wall.
Even without the cannon, it hurts.
You're tiny under my fist.
Bones crack sharply.
I strike and the floor splits.
Don't block my knee.
This palm sends you ten paces.
I catch my breath and go again.
The tube fire grazes you.
My fist presses you into the dirt.
Next punch uses my right.
You're really too slow to retreat.
That one had force behind it.
Lie down and stay there.
The ground sinks; I rise.
The fire in my tubes lights first.
Lava still drips off me.
The nether air feels good.
I stand up, and the ground sinks.
What a cramped space.
I look around.
Anything to eat here?
My footsteps carry far.
I cough out sparks.
I walk out with the cannon on my back.
Come on, don't be shy.
Fire on me just makes me hotter.
The fall shakes all of me.
Water in my tubes makes white steam.
The blast rocks me twice.
A bolt sticks in a tube.
Foul force seeps into my flesh.
When hungry, even I fear myself.
Lightning hits my back and I bend.

lines.zh: 这么大也照掉，我直往下。
lines.en: Even this bulk falls straight down.
